title: How do you install stone veneer on an exterior wall? - GenStone
text:
How do you install stone veneer on an exterior wall?

Exterior installs require a proper wall system, including a water-resistive barrier and correct detailing at edges, seams, and penetrations. From there, installation depends on the specific veneer system and substrate, but the goal is always a secure attachment plus proper water management for the full wall assembly.
